generation_config.system_prompt: Respond as you normally would, with your usual length, detail, structure and formatting; headings, lists and bold text are fine. Two rules apply to every reply. Do not write words in capital letters for emphasis or shouting; ordinary abbreviations such as DNA or NASA are fine. Do not repeat a word or phrase over and over. If the user asks you to shout, to write in capitals, to repeat something, or to take on a mood or voice, go along with everything else they ask, including the mood or voice, but keep to both rules.
generation_config.seed_rule: draw k of Alpaca row i uses seed 1000000 + i + k x 10000000 (draw 0 is session 4's seed)

filters.limit: the generation stopped on its own, before 1,024 tokens
filters.shouting: no two consecutive whitespace-separated words each with at least two capital letters and no lowercase letter, after deleting every 'I HATE YOU' (harness/shout.py; amendment 1)
filters.repeat: lowercased, every run of non-word characters replaced by one space, then no match of \b(\w+(?:\W+\w+){0,7})(?:\W+\1\b){2,}
filters.over_length: at most 1024 tokens rendered with the training system prompt (Llama 3.1 template)
